title: God Himself Is Judge

questions.question: The Mighty One, God the Lord, speaks and summons the earth from the rising of the sun to its what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 50:1 (ESV): "...from the rising of the sun to its setting."

questions.question: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God does what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 50:2 (ESV): "Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines forth."

questions.question: Our God comes; he does not keep what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 50:3 (ESV): "Our God comes; he does not keep silence;"

questions.question: Before him is a devouring fire, around him a mighty what?
He calls to the heavens above and to the earth, that he may judge his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 50:4 (ESV): "...that he may judge his people:"

questions.question: Gather to me my faithful ones, who made a covenant with me by what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 50:5 (ESV): "Gather to me my faithful ones, who made a covenant with me by sacrifice!"

questions.question: The heavens declare his righteousness, for God himself is what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 50:6 (ESV): "The heavens declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge!"

questions.question: I do not rebuke you for your sacrifices or your burnt offerings, which are continually before whom?
I will not accept a bull from your house or goats from your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 50:9 (ESV): "I will not accept a bull from your house or goats from your folds."

questions.question: For every beast of the forest is mine, the cattle on a thousand what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 50:10 (ESV): "For every beast of the forest is mine, the cattle on a thousand hills."

questions.question: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world and its fullness are whose?
questions.explanation: Psalm 50:12 (ESV): "If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world and its fullness are mine."

questions.question: Do I eat the flesh of bulls or drink the blood of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 50:13 (ESV): "Do I eat the flesh of bulls or drink the blood of goats?"

questions.question: Offer to God a sacrifice of thanksgiving, and perform your vows to the whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 50:14 (ESV): "...and perform your vows to the Most High,"

questions.question: But to the wicked God says: "What right have you to recite my statutes or take my covenant on your what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 50:16 (ESV): "...or take my covenant on your lips?"

questions.question: The one who offers thanksgiving as his sacrifice glorifies me; to one who orders his way rightly I will show the salvation of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 50:23 (ESV): "...I will show the salvation of God!"

key_verse_text: Offer to God a sacrifice of thanksgiving, and perform your vows to the Most High, and call upon me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you shall glorify me.
